Verified_Finding: Third-party civic OGD explorer lists 30 datasets under Administration -> Public Administration & Grievances; live https://www.data.gov.in/keywords/CPGRAMS returned inaccessible during automated check.
Implication_For_Study: Individual live UUIDs and update timestamps could not be enumerated directly from data.gov.in.

Verified_Finding: Published OGD resources (e.g., ap.data.gov.in/resource/year-wise-total-number-grievances-received) hold only annual national (2020-2024) and State/UT aggregate counts.
Implication_For_Study: OGD APIs lack ministry-month GRAI tables, active GRO logins, 21-day ageing splits, and case-level timestamps.

Verified_Finding: api.data.gov.in enforces API key tier rate limits and lags DARPG monthly reports by 12-24 months.
Implication_For_Study: DARPG Monthly Reports and Sansad Parliamentary Annexures remain the authoritative primary data spine.
